brief.aim: The table is the classic Cleveland heart-disease cohort whose assembled aim is detecting presence of disease; heart_disease_binary is the binarized recode of the ordinal angiographic grade num (0 vs any positive grade), so it is the sole target and num is a derived-from-target leakage column that must not be a feature. No ID, group, or time columns exist, so partitions are plain row splits.
brief.repeated_subjects: None discernible; each row is a distinct patient encounter with no subject key.
